'''flipout64 Learn the worse''' is the [[Light]] constructed list flipout64 posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-14811">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14811 Learn the worse], DeckTech (rad "flipout64" man, 25 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14811/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14811/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' flipout64
* '''Published:''' 25 March 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Learn the worse''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 MWYHL flipout64 LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' I jedi train on Dagobah and take no damage from force drains and battle. I make the opponent lose force and they cant stop it. Its a good deck that wins against a lot of different strategies.

== Original post ==

'''Learn the worse'''
* '''Author:''' rad "flipout64" man
* '''Published:''' March 25, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' I jedi train on Dagobah and take no damage from force drains and battle. I make the opponent lose force and they cant stop it. Its a good deck that wins against a lot of different strategies.

=== Strategy ===

I start out by training and try to finish as fast as possible (like usual). I stop force drains with Undercovers and It Could Be Worse and try not to battle on ground until later on when I'm finished with training. I keep my space support up and hold off what I can. I use the ASP and Ewok Catapult to get my 7 when ever I need it at Endor Docking Bay. Most ground beatdown decks are stuck and left with nothing to do. Read this, I substitute jedi test number 6 for 1 it could be worse.
